title: fix(spec): the dashboard Default Period select names its periods
body:
Fixes #36949
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW

This PR moves non-test `packages/spec/src` form text and owes an L2 contract review before it lands.

## 维护者速读

- 搭仪表盘的业务管理员在属性面板「筛选 → 日期范围」里选默认时间段时，下拉项从英文原始代码变成「本月」「近 30 天」这样的名称，英文界面读 This month 等；日期范围下的三行也有了名称。
- 属于"报表与仪表盘面板说业务话"这项体验工作，是报表那张同一问题卡的仪表盘一半，两边现在共用同一份时间段名称。
- 只改了选项和行的显示名称，保存的值和规则都不变；出错最多是某个名称读起来不对，可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

- **One table for both forms (`packages/spec/src/ui/default-period-options.ts`, new)**: the English period names (a record keyed by every `DateRangeDefaultRange`, so a preset added to the shared table fails to compile until it is named) moved out of `report.form.ts` into `defaultPeriodOptions()`. The module is not re-exported from the `ui` barrel, so the published surface is unchanged.
- **Producer (`packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.form.ts`)**: the `dateRange` composite now enumerates all three children, as the report form does: `field` (Date Field), `defaultRange` (a `select` with `defaultPeriodOptions()`) and `allowCustomRange`. Before, with no children declared, the row fell back to the schema enum and listed `today`, `this_month`, … raw. `report.form.ts` now reads the same function, so the two selects cannot drift.
- **Console zh (`ui/packages/app-shell`)**: #36928's `defaultPeriodLabelKey` and `withDefaultPeriodLabels` moved verbatim from `report-schema.ts` into `metadata-admin/default-period-labels.ts`, with the zh gate folded into one `localizeDefaultPeriods(form, locale, translate)`. Both `ReportDefaultInspector` and `DashboardDefaultInspector` call it, so a zh designer reads the period names from the console locale packs (the rows the period chip reads) in both panels. The dashboard overlay in `metadata-form-i18n.ts` names the three new child rows in zh.
- **Platform catalogs (`@objectstack/platform-objects`)**: `check-i18n-bundles --write` added the six new `metadataForms.dashboard.fields.dateRange.*` leaves to every locale. zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES are worded by hand (the catalog's three authored locales; the report form's wording for the same rows). The other locales carry the extractor's English fill, as for the report rows. `object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts`'s translated-label control moves 825 → 828 with a note: three row labels, authored in all three locales.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@object-ui/app-shell` (private), all patch.

**Read first** (by risk):
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/DashboardDefaultInspector.tsx`: the `useMemo` now depends on the app translator (`appT`) and runs `localizeDefaultPeriods` before `stackSectionsForNarrowPanel`.
2. `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.form.ts`: the three enumerated `dateRange` children. A declared `fields` list replaces the schema-derived one, so all three must be listed.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/default-period-labels.ts`: the moved helpers and the zh gate.

**Two-minute verification**: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/DashboardDefaultInspector.test.tsx`. Expected: 10 passed, including the en case (options read This quarter and the other names) and the zh case (本季度 / 本月 / 近 30 天 / 自定义…, with the row label 默认时间段 as the positive control).

## Tests

Its options equal the preset table in order, equal the report form's options, and each carries a name that is not its value.
- `DashboardDefaultInspector.test.tsx`: a new top-level `describe` (the existing harness, per the shared-harness rule). en and zh renders open the Filters section and the Default Period select and read its options. zh has a positive control (the row label 默认时间段 from the overlay). Module-top `@objectstack/formula` / `@objectstack/lint` imports, as in #36928's file, keep their first load out of a clocked case.
- `ReportDefaultInspector.defaultPeriodLabels-36835.test.tsx`: imports `defaultPeriodLabelKey` from its new home. Unchanged otherwise, still green.

- Spec: `ablation-replace --delete` removed the dashboard row's `options: defaultPeriodOptions(),` line. Anchor x1 to x0, blob `ba7afb59` to `f6cb0bd7`. Result: `offers the report form's named options, the preset table in order` failed (1 failed, 3 passed). Restore: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The spec pin imports the form from source, so no build was needed.
- Inspector: `ablation-replace` turned the shared zh gate into `if (!isZhLocale(locale) || true) return form;`. Anchor x1 to x0, blob `770ba759` to `6c93010b`. Result: `zh: every option reads the locale pack name` failed (1 failed, 9 passed). Restore: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The UI suite reads `app-shell` source.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Clause-② measured `no`**: no `*.zod.ts` file changed, and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` reports all 14 generated artifacts up to date, including `check:authorable-surface` and `check:api-surface`. No accept set moved; only form row and option names did.
- **Sharing, not copying**: the period names, their option list, the zh key mapping and the zh gate each exist once. The report form and inspector now read the shared pieces; their behaviour is unchanged (the #36835 pins pass as before).
- **New row help texts**: the dashboard's `dateRange.field` hint says an empty field filters on the creation date. That is the runtime default the dashboard schema documents (`dateRange.field ?? 'created_at'`).
- **Platform gap, still open (noted in #36928)**: form `options[].label` has no translation slot in `metadataForms`, so server-rendered forms show the English period names in every locale. This fix does not depend on that slot.
- Locales other than zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES carry the English fill for the six new catalog leaves, the same state as the report rows; `check:i18n-coverage` reports none new.
